title: ValueModel
description: Canonical Value Model (CVM) — defines variables, dependencies, value drivers, and tiers/modules for a product's value proposition. Implementations may extend the top-level object and any item with additional fields (e.g. competitive positioning, impact narratives, LLM build notes) without breaking conformance.

variables.description: All variables used by the value drivers.

display_name.description: A human-readable descriptive name for this variable.

description.description: A description of this variable and how its value can be determined.

type.description: The value type of this variable.

category.description: Variable category per the value driver taxonomy.

dependencies.description: Derived variable relationships. Omit if no dependencies exist.

variable.description: The name of the dependent variable.

equation.description: A JavaScript expression computing this variable from other variables in the list.

value_drivers.description: The value drivers for this solution. Each driver defines how to calculate the economic impact on a customer.

category.description: Value driver category per the value driver taxonomy.

subcategory.description: Value driver subcategory per the value driver taxonomy.

equation.description: A JavaScript expression computing the economic impact of this driver using only variable names declared in variables[].

description.description: A description of this value driver and its economic impact.

variables_used.description: All variable names referenced in this driver's equation.

continuity_profile.description: Whether the driver is one-time or recurring and how its impact evolves over time.

mode.description: Whether this driver provides a one-time uplift or an ongoing recurring improvement.

annual_decay_rate.description: If recurring, the fractional reduction in benefit each year.

time_horizon_years.description: If recurring, how many years the effect persists.

tiers_or_modules.description: Which tiers or modules this driver materially depends on. Empty array if solution-wide.

items.description: Name of a tier or module defined in tiers_and_modules[].

key_category_metric.description: The key metric used to track and verify realized value for this driver post-sale.

key_category_metric_equation.description: A JavaScript expression computing the key category metric from declared variables.

tiers_and_modules.description: Catalog of subscription tiers and add-on modules for this solution.

name.description: Display name of the tier or module.

module.description: True = add-on module; false = subscription tier.

description.description: Short description of what this tier or module includes.

includes.description: Names of other tiers or modules included in this one.
